mapper.select: select projected_decay_score >= 0.95 from public.agent_runtime_memory_usage_projection where tenant_id=#{tenant} and fact_id=#{fact} for update

select p.fact_id from agent_runtime_memory_usage_projection p join agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h on h.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and h.fact_id=p.fact_id join agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r on r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and r.fact_id=h.fact_id and r.revision=h.current_revision where p.tenant_id=#{tenant} and p.fact_id>#{after} and r.status='ACTIVE' order by p.fact_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: with candidates as ( select p.fact_id,p.updated_at,p.last_referenced_at,least(1, greatest(0, (extract(epoch from now()) - coalesce(extract(epoch from p.last_referenced_at), r.created_epoch_second + r.created_nano/1000000000.0))/7776000.0))::numeric(8,7) as score from agent_runtime_memory_usage_projection p join agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h on h.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and h.fact_id=p.fact_id join agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r on r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and r.fact_id=h.fact_id and r.revision=h.current_revision where p.tenant_id=#{tenant} and r.status='ACTIVE' and p.fact_id in #{fact} ), changed as ( select c.fact_id,c.score,c.last_referenced_at from candidates c join agent_runtime_memory_usage_projection p on p.tenant_id=#{tenant} and p.fact_id=c.fact_id where p.projected_decay_score is distinct from c.score ) update agent_runtime_memory_usage_projection p set projected_decay_score=c.score,updated_at=now() from changed c where p.tenant_id=#{tenant} and p.fact_id=c.fact_id and p.projected_decay_score is distinct from c.score and p.last_referenced_at is not distinct from c.last_referenced_at
mapper.select: select p.fact_id,h.current_revision as revision from agent_runtime_memory_usage_projection p join agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h on h.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and h.fact_id=p.fact_id join agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r on r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and r.fact_id=h.fact_id and r.revision=h.current_revision where p.tenant_id=#{tenant} and p.projected_decay_score >= 0.95 and r.status='ACTIVE' and p.fact_id > #{after} order by p.fact_id limit #{limit}
